rust_summary: A dispenser equips armor or equipment (`native_block_dispense_armor`).
doc_summary: A dispenser equips `item` on the first eligible player, mob or armor stand in front of its block at `pos`, after the item is consumed and the equip sound and game event are applied. `target` identifies the kind of entity equipped. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_dispense_armor@.
